name: On Reveal
text: Acts once, when the card is turned face up on the board: after it is played, and also when a location or card puts it there, unless something stops On Reveal (Cosmo).

name: Ongoing
text: A lasting effect that holds for as long as the card is on the board.

name: Activate
text: The card does nothing when played; from the turn after it was played its player can choose a turn to use the ability, which then happens as that turn plays out.

name: End of Turn
text: Acts at the end of every turn while the card is on the board.

name: Start of Turn
text: Acts at the start of every turn while the card is on the board.

name: Game Start
text: Acts when the game begins, from the deck or hand (Second Dinner: a wording, not yet a keyword with rules of its own).

name: Objective
text: A goal on the card with a counter (0/6); the counter counts from the start of the game, and the reward happens after the turn ends (after End of Turn effects) if the card is in play with the goal met.

name: Moveable
text: The card can be moved by its player.

name: Empowered
text: A card is Empowered when its Power is raised permanently (also by setting it higher); Power from Ongoing effects does not count.

name: Quickdraw
text: The stronger ability after the word is used instead of the normal one when the card is played on the same turn it was drawn.

name: Horde
text: The first time you play a Horde card you get a plain Zombie Horde card at a random location with 0 Power; every Horde +N adds N Power to your Zombie Horde.

name: Merge
text: A card merges into another: their Power is added together, the merged card goes under the other, and no ability happens again. It frees a place at the location.

name: Afflict
text: Give an enemy card negative Power.

name: Destroy
text: Remove a card from the board; destroyed cards are gone, there is no graveyard.

name: Discard
text: Remove a card from your hand.

name: Move
text: A card on the board goes to another location; not past the left or right location and not into a full one; its player, the opponent or a location can move it.

name: When Discarded
text: Acts when the card is discarded from its player's hand.
